title: New Uri Geller
summary: A reader, Mario, attempts to hypnotize the magazine 'proud' into giving his band a free advertising page. He uses classic hypnotic induction techniques, counting to three and snapping his fingers. The magazine, however, firmly rejects his request.
excerpt: Dear proud, You are getting very sleepy... very, very sleepy... Your eyes are getting heavy... You can't keep them open... You are sinking deep... yes... stop fighting... just give up... Mario
